cohort: 643 primiparous women without a history of mental disorders who delivered singleton babies at a single institute in Japan between September 2018 and June 2019
finding: Women who had an elective caesarean section had higher scores on the EPDS and MIBS, indicating worse mental health outcomes, than women who had a vaginal delivery or an emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of high scores of the EPDS and the MIBS in women choosing elective cesarean section were higher than in women with vaginal delivery and emergency cesarean section.
